{{Top}}
The '''Cassandran Worlds''', known as the '''Cassandran Sectors''' under the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], were a region of loosely-allied planets located within [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] northern quadrant in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. The Cassandran Worlds were established roughly a [[Standard century/Legends|century]] before the fall of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] by [[Cassander Tadrin]], a bored [[Esselian]] businessman who was tired of the self-satisfaction lifestyle of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. After funding a series of missions into the galaxy to discover new [[Planet/Legends|planets]], he led tens of thousands of his loyal employees and their families to settle the new planets. The Cassandran Worlds consisted of over a hundred planets, including [[Cassander]], [[New Bakstre]], [[Minashee/Legends|Minashee]], [[Garqi/Legends|Garqi]], [[Forsen]], [[Biitu]], [[Isiring]] and [[Monhudle]]. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Sifo-Dyas/Legends|Sifo-Dyas]] hailed from the region.<ref name="Geonosis">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref>

Shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Galactic Empire [[Annexation of the Cassandran Worlds|annexed]] the Cassandran Worlds. They split the region into three distinct [[Sector/Legends|subsectors]] known as the Cassandran Sectors&mdash;[[Cassander sector/Legends|Cassander]], [[Tadrin sector/Legends|Tadrin]], and [[Tendrannan sector/Legends|Tendrannan]].<ref name="Geonosis" />
